chapter_title_arabic: ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنباً

duas.dua_text_english: There is not any slave of Allah who commits a sin, then he perfects his purification and stands to pray two Rak'ahs of prayer, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, except that Allah will forgive him.
duas.dua_text_transliteration: Mā min 'abdin yudhnib dhanbān fa-yuḥsin aṭ-ṭuhūr, thumma yaqūm fa-yuṣallī rak'atayn, thumma yastaghfir Allāh illā ghafara Allāhu lah.
duas.dua_text_arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
duas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86, At-Tirmidhi 2/257. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/283.
